title: Agile Project Estimator (AgileEE)
summary: A Streamlit application that uses trained machine learning models to give early effort estimates (man-months) for Agile software projects based on project parameters like industry, team size and complexity. Its data-preparation notebooks use SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and SingleTableMetadata to generate synthetic training data for the estimator.
